provider.name: SILVA Ribosomal RNA Database
provider.organization_type: global ribosomal RNA sequence, alignment, taxonomy, phylogeny, quality-control, reference-dataset, primer-testing, amplicon-analysis, software, and download infrastructure
provider.description: SILVA is a curated resource for small- and large-subunit ribosomal RNA sequences from Bacteria, Archaea, and Eukaryota. It provides comprehensive and reference datasets, multiple-sequence alignments, taxonomic classifications, reference trees, quality metrics, release archives, ARB databases, SINA alignment, TestPrime primer evaluation, SILVAngs amplicon processing, and integration resources for microbial ecology and phylogenetics.
institutional_context: Microbial taxonomy, phylogeny, and environmental sequencing communities
Research institutes, universities, sequence archives, culture collections, and software projects

purpose.summary: This file is a crawl-ready source catalog for collecting SILVA documentation, organization, releases, SSU and LSU datasets, taxonomy, sequence identifiers, metadata, alignments, phylogenetic trees, quality control, SINA, TestPrime, SILVAngs, APIs, downloads, formats, curation workflows, licenses, citations, software, standards, and related authorities.
purpose.authoritative_notice: SILVA, official release files and notes, ARB and SINA documentation, INSDC source records, type-strain and nomenclatural authorities, cited publications, and official repositories remain authoritative for sequences, accessions, taxonomy, alignments, identifiers, versions, rights, and contacts.

Separate source nucleotide sequences from SILVA curation, taxonomy, alignments, trees, metadata, software, and services.
Preserve SILVA release, accession version, sequence source, taxonomy source and version, file name, checksum, citation, access date, license URI, rights holder, and provenance.
Do not assume all INSDC records, taxonomic mappings, reference trees, alignments, or software share the same rights.
Seed URLs are best-effort and were not live-verified in this session.
The acquisition program should update retrieval, content, review, and verification fields in place.

SILVA routes, release numbers, file names, archive layout, sequence counts, taxonomy, SINA versions, SILVAngs behavior, API availability, and license wording may change; preserve redirect and failure metadata.
Do not recursively crawl every sequence, accession, taxon, alignment, tree node, browser result, SILVAngs project, API result, or archive file when the task is documentation acquisition.
Do not store credentials, API keys, passwords, cookies, tokens, private SILVAngs project data, unpublished curation notes, or session identifiers.
Source sequences, SILVA taxonomy, alignments, trees, metadata, software, web services, and third-party mappings may carry different rights.
